method: Fresh read of the five changed modules diff and surrounding mutation/receipt/timeout lifecycle, with native implementation contract comparison. Independently read affected real HTTP/Ledger restart tests and browser operation tests. No repeated test execution.
conclusions: Explicit idle write method registered; no old backup API or consent transport retained.
Success receipt retains distinct new identity and provider/source identifiers but strips title, history and private paths.
Error partial identity is accepted only for thread/convert, matching source request, distinct bounded new ID and inputSent=false. It preserves not_sent/unknown without inferring completion.
Persistent Ledger replay test closes/reopens database and proves the unknown/new-ID result is returned without a second worker request.
Only conversion has browser360s timeout above worker350s. Ordinary operations retain existing30s. No automatic timeout retry.
Successful conversion receipt remains recoverable until destination chat consumes it; original source view cannot prematurely collect it.
limits: This is the five-module interface review, not a new whole-source audit or full test gate.
No browser/network/online mutation was executed for this review.
